class.name: SentryWebOptions
class.brief_description: Web-specific options for the Sentry SDK.
class.description: Contains configuration options that apply only when the project runs on Web, such as tunneling. Access this configuration through [member SentryOptions.web]. See also [SentryOptions].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], sends uploads through a managed tunnel configured by [member tunnel_path], [member tunnel_base_path], and [member tunnel_trailing_slash]. If [code]false[/code], sends directly to Sentry and ignores these options. Configure a server on the game's origin to handle the tunnel path and forward envelopes to Sentry. The [member SentryOptions.dsn] is still required.

Prefixes the tunnel path, including an explicit [member tunnel_path]. For example, [code]"/game"[/code] with [code]"/events"[/code] sends uploads to [code]"/game/events"[/code]. An empty string adds no prefix.
Sets the tunnel path on the game's origin, such as [code]"/events"[/code]. An empty string derives a stable path from [member SentryOptions.dsn].
If [code]true[/code], appends [code]/[/code] to the tunnel path. Use this when the server requires a trailing slash, including for a DSN-derived path.
